explication: AirTroller is an iOS app that discovers nearby AirDrop devices, lets the user choose recipients and an image, then manages repeated sender operations and cancellation. The sampled controller and UI show the main workflow; Sharing.swift dynamically binds to Apple’s private Sharing framework. Framework-to-callback edges reflect the registered callbacks in the sampled source.
